name: mirage
text: Yes. With Run on GitHub on, every setting on your phone is mirrored to the engine, and the Bids tab modes are part of that. The engine reads those settings and the phone only displays and edits them. Making the tab a dedicated engine control is still on my list (CH73c). Right now it works like this. Off: no bids are posted or suggested. Recommend: the engine finds bids that pass the rules and tells you about them, but posts nothing. Auto: the engine posts real resting bids with its own trading key, sized by the Kelly and wallet settings. Your setting is Auto right now, and engine trading is LIVE, so Auto means real bids. The bid desk was halted until my restart a few minutes ago, so I haven't yet seen new bids resting.
